name: Wasuremono to Otoshimono
source:
When I went to the game center, I catch sight of "her", playing that game alone.

I wonder when was it that I fell for her.

[From [url=http://insertcoin.languex.jp/about.html]homepage[/url]]
translation:
我去電玩場時，看見了獨自玩著那款遊戲的「她」。

我究竟是從什麼時候開始喜歡上她的呢？

[摘自[url=http://insertcoin.languex.jp/about.html]官方網站[/url]]
